description: Send a message to Discord via the bot's TEXT_DIR outbox (no token needed, goes through the running bot). Configure DISCORD_DEFAULT_CHANNEL_ID in .env to avoid passing channel_id each time.
name: harness_discord_outbox

channel_id.description: Discord channel ID (or DM channel ID). Optional if DISCORD_DEFAULT_CHANNEL_ID is set.

label.description: Label for the outbox file (default: harness).
